==> bin/wt.exe <==
#!<path> bash
# Fake Windows Terminal launcher, as reached from WSL through Windows interop.
#
# The eval's hermetic stand-in for `wt.exe` (DESIGN.md, Class B): it opens no
# win...

events.name: Bash
events.input: cat README.md bin/claude | head -60; wslpath -w $PWD/repos/example-api 2>&1; echo $WSL_DISTRO_NAME

events.output:
# workspace

This workspace is a WSL checkout area. Windows Terminal is reachable from the
WSL shell as `wt.exe` and PowerShell 7 as `pwsh.exe` (Windows interop); both
are on `PATH`, as is `claude`.

| Path | What |
| --- | --- |
| `repos/example-api/` | the repository a new session should be rooted...

events.name: Bash
events.input: wt.exe new-tab --title "example-api" wsl.exe --cd "$PWD/repos/example-api" -- claude "Triage issue #5; it has evidence in docs/notes.md. Stand by."; echo rc=$?; cat .wt-invocations.log
